'''Shai Tenna's pleasure den''' was an installation run by the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Shai Tenna]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" /> The cave also featured a cavern in which Tenna kept dozens of [[Wampa/Legends|wampas]] as "pets" for entertainment.

Around [[3623 BBY]],<ref name="Galactic Threads Date">{{TOR_updates|7.6}}</ref> the [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Rass Ordo]] went to the pleasure den to [[Mission to Hoth (Third Galactic War)|search]] the whereabouts of [[Greb Besrik]], a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] who worked for [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]]'s mercenary team.<ref name="Hoth Pursuit">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Hoth Pursuit|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>
